sanskrit: yato jīvebhyo na pitṝn upaiti yam ānaśe duṣkṛtaṃ daidhiṣavyam | ayajñiyaḥ prathamo yo viveśa kṛcchrād ij jyotir abhy aśnavātai ||
english: From that [realm] where the living do not draw near to the pitṛs — [that realm] which the evil deed of the daidhiṣavya has overtaken him — the first who entered, unfit for sacrifice: may he win back the light from that misery.

sanskrit: nāsyauṣadhīṣv apy asti nāpsv antar nāsya sūryaṃ saṃdṛśam eti cakṣuḥ | bhūmir dveṣṭi carantam enaṃ yam ānaśe duṣkṛtaṃ daidhiṣavyam ||
english: For him there is nothing in the herbs, nothing within the waters; his eye does not come to meet the sight of the sun; the earth abhors him as he wanders — him whom the evil deed of the daidhiṣavya has overtaken.

sanskrit: trite devā amṛjataina etat trita enan manuṣyeṣv amṛṣṭa | tata etad amuyā rakṣa īrte pramuktaṃ jyoter adhi dūram eti ||
english: The gods wiped this [sin] away onto Trita; Trita wiped it off upon humankind; thence this [sin], propelled by yonder demon, speeds far away beyond the light, set free.

sanskrit: yebhiḥ pāśair didhiṣūpatir vibaddhaḥ parauparāv ārpito aṅgeaṅge | vi te cṛtyantāṃ vicṛto hi santi bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛṣṭā ||
english: The bonds with which the husband of the didhiṣū was bound, thrust one upon another in limb after limb — may they be cut asunder, for they are severed indeed; O Pūṣan, the sins of the fetus-slayer are wiped away.

sanskrit: agniṣ ṭe viśa ā nayād indro vāyur bṛhaspatiḥ | sa te dharmam adīdharad dhāteva bhuvanebhyaḥ ||
english: May Agni lead your clan hither — Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati; may he establish your dharma, as Dhātṛ did for the worlds.

sanskrit: bṛhaspate puraetā viśām ihy agniḥ paścād abhi nudāty āyatīḥ | vāyur enā dakṣiṇataḥ pūṣottarād upānudāt ||
english: O Bṛhaspati, go as forerunner of the clans; Agni from behind urges forward those who are approaching; may Vāyu drive them from the right side, and Pūṣan from the north, urging them along.

sanskrit: ā sahasrī śataratha ā revānyetu no viśam | endro vāmena viśpatir ā rūpeṇa bṛhaspatiḥ ||
english: May our clan come to us thousandfold in [people], hundredfold in chariots, rich in gifts; may Indra [come] with bounty, the lord of the clan Bṛhaspati with splendor.

sanskrit: svarjuṣṭaḥ kaśyapasya sa rāṣṭre jāgarat sve | ṛṣabhaḥ śātamāturaḥ śvetantād avihruto devān yajñena bodhayāt ||
english: He who is dear to svarga — [the son] of Kaśyapa — may he be ever wakeful in his own kingdom; the bull of a hundred mothers, undetached from the white [line of descent], may he rouse the gods through sacrifice.

sanskrit: mahājanāḥ prathamā ye didīvire dhane saṃhatya mahati dvirāje | teṣāṃ vare yaḥ prathamo jigāya tasyāhaṃ lokam anūd bhideyam ||
english: The great men, those foremost who blazed forth in wealth, having joined together in the great double-king [dice game] — among the best of them, he who conquered first: that world of his I would cleave open [for myself].

sanskrit: medinas te vaibhīdakās tata indra upāvatu | avyā vṛka iva saṃrabhya jigīvān astam āyasi ||
english: Your medinas, those vaibhīdaka [dice] — from there, O Indra, come to our aid; grasping [your prize] like a wolf upon a sheep, may you return home victorious.

sanskrit: udbāhū hiraṇyajid gojid aśvajitau bhare | vyāghro jaghnivām̐ iva- -ut tiṣṭhādhidevanāt ||
english: With arms raised high — winner of gold, winner of cattle, winner of horses in the contest — rise up like a tiger that has made its kill, above the [place of] gambling.

sanskrit: ādinavaṃ pratidīvne kṛtenāsmām̐ abhi kṣara | vṛkṣam ivāśanyā jahi yo asmān pratidīvyati ||
english: Flow over me in full freshness with the winning cast [kṛta] against my dice-opponent; smite, as a thunderbolt smites a tree, him who plays against us at dice.
